verdict.rationale: mise has no separate GUI; its entire surface is a documented CLI (mise-probe-4). Everything is scriptable: tool installs, exec, tasks, settings, env-var overrides, CI wrappers. Some machine-readable output exists (`--json` on `mise lock`), and an official MCP server lets AI assistants inspect tools, tasks, env and config and run tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of consistent machine-readable (JSON) output across all commands, an explicit parity statement, and independent corroboration of agent-driven use.
